Assignments may be funded by, among others, the European Union, the Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Finland, development finance institutions and other international cooperation partners. Innovation, Investment Readiness & Technical Assistance 4. Communications, Media, Creative & Visibility Services The DPS is open to suppliers from Finland and internationally. Suppliers may apply to one or several categories and, once admitted, will have the opportunity to participate in mini-competitions launched throughout the DPS period 2026–2030. Further information regarding the scope, eligibility requirements and application process is provided in the procurement documents.
